title: mcp/runtime comments still say `run_action` takes `confirm: true`
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: an out-of-scope finding confirmed in the L2 contract-review record 6933569098 on PR #34532 (card #34387), passed on by area `o2-A`. It is a bookkeeping fix: internal comments only, with no product-visible change. Dedupe: `run_action confirm: true comment`.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：两处内部注释还写着 `run_action` 收 `confirm: true`,和现在的确认流程对不上。一处是 `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 里 `recordDeleteConfirmationRefusal` 的 docblock,一处在 `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`。
- 为什么要修:AI 改这块代码时会读这些注释，旧说法会把它带回已经退役的写法。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

Rewrite both comments to say what `run_action` does now, in the wording of the merged #34387 guidance. Point at that single source and do not restate it. Change comments only, no code.

## Re-check

`grep -n "run_action" packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts | grep -i "confirm"`. Re-run after PR #34532 merges; if it lists no line that says `run_action` takes `confirm: true`, close this card as fixed.

## Done when

That grep lists no comment saying `run_action` takes `confirm: true`. Other tools' legitimate `confirm: true` (delete_record, bulk delete) stay as they are.
